releaseNotes: MultiClone Pro v4.3.2 - Clone opening fix. Based on developer's root-cause analysis: (1) ContentProviderCompat now 4s time-bound wait (was 0.6s), (2) HookManager isolates each injector + launch-critical hooks first, (3) HCallbackProxy time-based bind retry (5s), (4) handleBindApplication retries on getPackageInfo null with logging. Keeps all v4.2.5/v4.2.6 features.
